name: Brant Business Interiors
description: Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Ontario commercial office furniture dealer at 296 George St N, Peterborough — toll-free 1-800-835-9565, quote response within 1 business day. Family-owned since 1964. OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470. Part of the Office Central Group of Companies.

mainEntity.name: Are ergonomic products OECM-eligible under Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Ergonomic chairs, desk converters, monitor arms, keyboard trays, and adjustable accessories in this collection are all covered under OECM Agreement 2025-470. Ontario school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits can purchase on an OECM purchase order — useful when running an ergonomic refresh across multiple workstations. Call 1-800-835-9565 or email quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com referencing the agreement.

mainEntity.name: Which brands do you carry for ergonomic furniture and accessories?

acceptedAnswer.text: ObusForme is the ergonomic specialist line we lead with — a Canadian brand built around posture support and adjustable seating. ergoCentric (also a Canadian-owned ergonomic specialist) is brokered through quote-only channels for ergonomic chairs and accessories. For standard ergonomic options — height-adjustable desks, monitor arms, basic adjustable task chairs — Global Furniture Group and OTG cover the volume catalog. Brant Business Interiors quotes specialist and standard lines side-by-side so the buyer can pick the right fit per workstation.

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade existing fixed-height desks with a sit-stand converter instead of replacing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — desk converters sit on top of an existing fixed-height desk and let the user raise or lower their work surface without buying a new desk. They're the lower-cost path when budgets don't cover full desk replacement, or when leased office space limits how much furniture you want to swap out. Converters come in single-monitor and dual-monitor footprints, in manual and electric versions. Call 1-800-835-9565 with the existing desk model and the monitor setup and we'll size a converter that fits.

mainEntity.name: When does it make sense to spec a specialist ergonomic chair instead of a standard task chair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard task chairs from Global Furniture Group or OTG cover most institutional desk work — adjustable seat height, seat depth, lumbar, and armrests. Specialist ergonomic chairs from ObusForme or ergoCentric come into play when a staff member has specific postural needs, when the role involves extended monitor work without regular breaks, or when the buyer is standardizing on dedicated ergonomic seating across a department. We'll walk through the comparison if you want a recommendation — call 1-800-835-9565 with the workstation type and we'll quote both options.
